$comment: Starter blocks for trying the live plan review. Copy to <repo>/.harness/plan/blocks.json — see chat instructions.

blocks.title: Phase intent
blocks.text: 1.0 stabilization: remove the legacy Code Analyzer v4 path so v5 is the only engine. Blocks are authored; everything else on this page is derived ground truth.

blocks.title: How a verdict becomes an improvement
blocks.source:
flowchart LR
  B[conductor-builder] -->|VERDICT| RV[record-verdict.mjs]
  RV --> DB[(history.db)]
  RV --> J[telemetry.jsonl]
  J -->|mined weekly| HI[harness-improver]
  HI -->|PR| R[repo]
  R -->|graded by| V[conductor-verifier]
  V -->|VERDICT| RV

blocks.title: Telemetry travels as tracked JSONL
blocks.choice: record-verdict.mjs mirrors every row into tracked .harness/telemetry.jsonl
blocks.rationale: The SQLite db is machine-local and gitignored; CI can only see what's in the checkout.

annotations.note: db row: local trend queries via `sfdt history`
JSONL mirror: the row CI actually mines
